# Local component proof alone does not establish the shipped composition

## Situation and impact

Local component proof alone does not establish the shipped composition. This work serves the approved North Star goal of less consumer rework and faster correct development.

## Current slice and scope

Integrated source/export, release helper and issue-owned Goal Run.

Synchronize the final export, run integrated required checks and distinct review, derive useful release notes, choose a compatible version, publish once, verify public release and install refresh, then close children and parent with captured evidence.

## Acceptance and verification

Required checks pass with skipped checks disclosed; review artifacts and consumer outputs are durable. Published commit/tag/version match. Final Goal proof binds exact children and evidence, and separate GitHub readback confirms CLOSED.

## Execution contract

- Dependencies: contract-ownership, evidence-meaning, spec-impl-journey, cli-journey, friction-reduction; local deliverable readiness unlocks work while provider closure waits for the final published carrier.
- Operator delegated ambiguity resolution and encountered-friction repair on 2026-09-06; final push and release are authorized. No open product decision requires another interview.
- Use isolated bounded implementation and independent review where evidence semantics or a removed observer changes. Parent integrates and verifies.
- Preserve unrelated work and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md. No new evaluator platform or general repo rewrite.
- Record actual commands, input/output identity, failures and non-claims. A passing local test or a CLOSED state alone is not consumer behavior proof.
- Close after the final release carrier is published and read back; parent owns Goal Run metadata and final close.

## Planning provenance

Before a consumer baseline, freeze fixture bytes, actual command assertions,
agent model/effort, host settings, allowed intervention and the same-input
repeated-operation counting rule in the existing probe source packet. No
post-hoc oracle change may support an improvement claim.

Parent acceptance review names each predicate's direct output channel, separate
observer and tested revision. Before close, bind those bytes to the published
carrier by equivalence or focused rerun. Local readiness requires captured
implementation, focused proof and applicable independent review with only
publication outstanding; open provider state does not prevent dependent work.

# Local simplification is incomplete until the shipped composition and Goal closeout are observed

## Capability and fixed decisions

Feature; dependencies: closeout-carrier, release-reuse, context-reuse, consumer-comparison at local proof readiness. Subject to explicit publication authority, integrate once, publish one release, observe the installed composition and close this Goal through its real provider graph. No new authority arises from a passing test or reviewer.

## Acceptance and proof

- Audit each A1-A6 criterion against actual evidence and mark remaining limitations. Mechanism cost/equality and product pilot results remain separate; unfavorable pilot results do not disappear from notes.
- Parent serially integrates and syncs generated exports; focused owner checks, standing runner, full read-only, applicable changed-line/verdict proof and release lane execute at their owning boundaries. The new eligible reuse path is exercised, not merely unit tested.
